description:
## Goal
A bare selectively imported callable value should obtain its required published kind through the ordinary dependency scheduler. A known but not yet demanded provider is pending work, not an unsupported-language error. Preserve macro-as-runtime-value rejection and exact diagnostic provenance.

## Reproduction and evidence
One source, with no source replacement or duplicate owner:
```
defmodule Math do
  fn add(a, b), do: a + b
end
import Math, only: [add: 2]
fn main() do
  f = add
  f.(1, 2)
end
```
Expected interpreter result: 3, no diagnostics. Accepted fz-tfn.48 immutable binary /tmp/fz-tfn48-final.I3A9oR/fz2 (SHA256 7e49e354cd3d6e0ebbd25baa40a98f04017e13f8ede53978e7c1d640a6935d55) independently reproduces lower/unsupported "needs the callable kind for add" at the add reference. Root fixture: /tmp/fz-tfn46-imported-kind-baseline.UKruIP/main.fz, interp exits 1.

Production test imported_callable_value_waits_for_its_provider_kind in the uncommitted .46 candidate reproduces the same failure: /tmp/fz-tfn46-imported-callable-red.log. Causal /tmp/fz-tfn46-imported-callable-causal-red.log proves DefineModule(Math) starts zero times and ModuleInterface remains absent. The .46 actual-read prototype /tmp/fz-tfn46-imported-callable-read-prototype.log retains Current(ModuleInterface(Math)) in the failed lowerer but still does not demand its producer. Observing a failed attempt's dependency is not the same as waiting for a prerequisite.

## Current model and strategy
ScopeSession::apply_import can bind NamespaceSymbol::Callable from a selective import before publication, recording an exact callable expectation. Bare f=add bypasses call expansion and reaches Lowerer::lower_expr Expr::Var, which needs interface kind to distinguish function from macro. It currently emits a fatal diagnostic for missing kind. The .46 correction retains actual observations and gates private interface storage; it does not make pending into a blocking outcome.

Work from the existing job completion and dependency model. Represent a real required-but-unavailable input as pending at the point of use and route it through existing producer demand. Investigate a typed lowering outcome at the existing boundary rather than rescanning expressions or treating all fatal reads as waits. An environment-blind prepass would falsely demand imports shadowed by local variables. No new retained registry, private queue, scanner, global retry pass, or function/macro identity authority. Collapse redundant requirement machinery where proven safe.

## Acceptance
- The one-source example returns 3 with no transient user diagnostic and demands the existing provider only because its kind is required.
- Published function values and actual reads remain correct; published macros remain rejected at the original reference span.
- An earlier successful kind read survives a later fatal expression; missing provider and genuinely invalid import remain terminal with exact provenance.
- Local shadowing and unused selective imports do not demand the provider; nested expressions/closures obey their actual lexical environment.
- Unchanged successful requests run zero compiler jobs; unrelated edits cause no requested-root work; relevant interface movement triggers only exact dependents. No blanket retry or new healthy scans/copies.
- Preserve existing healthy work budgets and semantic/native artifacts; prove reductions causally. Remove temporary probes and the old missing-kind fatal path if replaced; update documentation, full relevant gates, and ticket-scoped cold review before one commit/close.

## Placement
This is a independently reproduced pre-existing pending-demand defect, not a regression introduced by .46. It remains required within the epic and blocks final fz-tfn.39 acceptance. .46 separately fixes exact failed/successful observation retention; no pending-outcome expansion is authorized as part of that observation correction. Preserve the RED source and assertions here instead of leaving a newly failing or ignored test in a differently scoped ticket. Re-evaluate exact dependencies when implementing from bw ready; do not implement speculative source-ownership policy from fz-tfn.53.
title: Demand published kinds for bare imported callable values
